name: Texas Muslim Womens Foundation Inc
mission: Founded in 2005, Texas Muslim Women's Foundation (TMWF) aims to empower, promote and support all women and their families, with a special focus on North Texas. We are an equal opportunity provider. We engage all members of the community – women, men, seniors, families and youth through our various programs. We provide social and family violence services that foster peace and well-being in the home through our Peace in the Home Services and Peaceful Oasis Shelter. In addition, TMWF also arranges leadership skills development for Muslim youth to inspire the next generation to build a promising future for our society and educational programs for Muslim and non-Muslim community members to learn about topics essential to individual and community welfare.
theoryOfChange: By providing a holistic approach—combining immediate crisis shelter with long-term transitional housing, legal aid, and economic empowerment—survivors can move from crisis to independence.

rich_narrative.summary: The Texas Muslim Women's Foundation (TMWF) is a specialized social service provider that has served North Texas since its <cite id="1">founding in 2005</cite>. The organization operates with a high degree of accountability, maintaining an <cite id="2">overall score of 98.7/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>. TMWF focuses on addressing domestic violence and providing social services both within and beyond the Muslim community. In FY2024, the foundation managed <cite id="3">$3,769,366 in total revenue</cite> to support its mission. While the organization saw a <cite id="4">revenue decline from $4,665,216 in FY2023</cite>, it continues to deliver critical direct services. These include <cite id="5">emergency shelter for 137 residents</cite> and support for <cite id="6">216 non-residential domestic violence clients</cite> according to recent filings. The foundation's model is built on direct service delivery, ensuring that resources reach survivors in need across <cite id="7">Collin, Dallas, Denton, Rockwall, and Tarrant counties</cite>. By providing culturally sensitive support, TMWF fills a vital gap in the domestic violence service landscape for Muslim and immigrant families in the region.
